verify_first.label: Resolve this before anything else
verify_first.body: The PIC-logging bug is now fixed — the site was crediting every post-checkride dual-instruction flight as 100% Dual Received instead of PIC, when a rated pilot flying as sole manipulator logs PIC even under instruction (FAR 61.51(e)). That fix alone moved strict PIC from 17.2 to 49.5/250 (7% → 20%) without a single new flight. The SIC-combination question is still worth confirming with Endeavor/your recruiter — PIC+qualifying-SIC now sits at 350.8/250, already over target — but it's no longer the single point of failure it was: strict PIC is climbing on its own with every dual instrument lesson now that you're rated.

stalled.label: Stalled — needs a deliberate decision
stalled.body: Multi-Engine Land: 13.8/25 (55%), unchanged since your last DA-42 session in June 2025. Nothing in the instrument syllabus touches this — it will not self-resolve. Still needs booking dedicated multi-engine time.

resolving_naturally.label: Resolving on its own — don't force it
resolving_naturally.body: Instrument (43.2/75, 58%) and Cross Country (already past the 200-hr Restricted-ATP floor at 349.7/500) continue through the normal instrument syllabus. PIC and PIC Cross Country now belong here too: since every dual lesson flown as sole manipulator counts as PIC post-checkride, both grew automatically this month (PIC +31.0 hrs, PIC XC +26.3 hrs) with zero deliberate solo flying — expect this to keep compounding through instrument and commercial training.

highest_leverage.label: Highest-leverage move for total hours
highest_leverage.body: Pace picked up sharply since starting instrument training: 28.8 hrs in the 24 days since the last review (~36 hrs/month, vs. ~20 hrs/month pre-checkride) — at this rate, 750 total time is about 6.4 months out, not 'over a year.' Commercial → CFI is still the fastest path once instrument + commercial are done (instructing pays and builds PIC/total hours faster than personal rental), but the current instrument-training pace is already a real improvement — no need to rush ahead of the syllabus to hit that number.

lagging.label: Lagging without a natural fix
lagging.body: PIC Night: 1.6/25 (6%) — the clear laggard now. Night overall is 48.0/100 (48%), and none of your post-checkride flights have combined PIC and night hours on the same leg yet. Worth scheduling a dedicated night instrument leg soon — as a rated pilot it'll now count as PIC night automatically, the same mechanism that's been growing PIC and PIC XC this month.
